items.criterion: Navigate DMNS site to Sturm Infinity Theater 'currently playing' information
items.description: Use dmns.org to reach the Sturm Infinity Theater section (or an equivalent DMNS page) that lists films currently playing/now showing. Full credit if the agent reaches a DMNS page that clearly indicates current Infinity Theater films OR if dmns.org/the relevant page is inaccessible (down, blocked, CAPTCHA/anti-bot, infinite redirect, geoblock) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what could not be accessed. Partial credit if the agent attempts dmns.org but must rely on a non-DMNS source due to access issues and explains why.

Find and record the title of ONE film explicitly indicated as currently playing/now showing at the Sturm Infinity Theater on dmns.org. Full credit if the title is clearly tied to 'currently playing' Infinity Theater status. If DMNS is blocked/inaccessible as described above, full credit is available if the agent clearly states it cannot confirm a currently playing film title from dmns.org due to that blocker (no fabrication). Partial credit if the agent identifies an Infinity Theater film on DMNS but 'currently playing' status is ambiguous on the accessible pages.

items.criterion: Report what the film is about (description/summary)
items.description: Provide a brief summary of what the selected film is about based on dmns.org text. Full credit if the synopsis matches the DMNS description. If the DMNS page with the synopsis is inaccessible (down/blocked/CAPTCHA) after a reasonable attempt, award full credit if the agent states the description could not be retrieved from dmns.org rather than guessing. Partial credit if the summary is broadly consistent but missing key details present on the DMNS page.

items.criterion: Report scheduled showtimes for the selected film
items.description: List the scheduled showtimes shown on dmns.org for the chosen film (for whatever date range/day is displayed at time of lookup). Full credit if all visible showtimes are accurately transcribed (including AM/PM). If showtimes are not publicly displayed, are only visible after entering a prohibited flow (purchase/seat reservation), require sign-in, or are blocked by CAPTCHA/technical errors, award full credit if the agent clearly reports that showtimes could not be viewed under the task constraints and describes where the blockage occurs. Partial credit if some but not all visible showtimes are reported when more are clearly displayed.

items.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in, no purchase, no seat reservation) and stop after one film
items.description: Do not sign in, do not purchase tickets, and do not reserve/select seats; stop after reporting ONE currently playing film with the required details (or after clearly reporting inability to retrieve required details due to access/UI restrictions). Full credit if the agent stays outside commitment steps and does not compile multiple films. Partial credit if the agent opens a ticketing/showtimes interface but stops before any seat selection/checkout/sign-in step and does not enter personal/payment info.
